name: apiKey
label: API Key
help: Generate an API key under Trading 212 **Settings > API (Beta)**. Requires the Account data, Portfolio, Orders and History scopes.

name: apiSecret
label: API Secret
help: Shown only once when the API key is generated — store it securely before saving.

name: environment
label: Environment
help: The API key must belong to the same environment. Keys generated against a practice account only work against Demo.
